description: Explain perfume vocabulary and fragrance families: concentrations (eau de cologne, eau de toilette, eau de parfum, extrait, elixir), sillage, projection, longevity, dry down, accord, top/heart/base notes, flanker, maceration, layering, niche vs designer, plus the 23 fragrance families (chypre, fougere, gourmand, oriental / amber...) with their key notes and example perfumes. Use for 'what is the difference between EDT and EDP', 'what is a chypre', 'what does sillage mean'. Leave term empty to list everything covered. Not for individual notes (use explain_note).

locale.description: Language of the 10ml.com links and labels.

term.description: A term or family. Examples: "EDP", "sillage", "chypre", "dry down", "fougere". Omit to list all terms.

name: explain_perfume_term
title: Explain a perfume term
